headline: CJP Protest Detainees Blocked at Azad Maidan
summary: Police detained several demonstrators and blocked entry to Azad Maidan during a CJP protest in Goa. Authorities denied the group permission to hold the protest in Panaji.

headline: Two Arrested for IIT Goa Exam Cheating
summary: Two individuals were booked and arrested at the Goa airport for cheating in the IIT Goa recruitment exam. Authorities recovered Bluetooth earpieces and SIM cards from the suspects.

headline: Rahul Gandhi's Goa Visit Postponed
summary: Rahul Gandhi's scheduled visit to Goa for the Goy Rakhonn Yatra has been called off amid ongoing protests. Meanwhile, Congress leaders have vowed to defy bans and proceed with planned rallies.

headline: Goa Police Probes Rs 1.27 Crore Job Scam
summary: Goa police have registered multiple FIRs in connection with a major fraud involving fake job promises and property deals totaling Rs 1.27 crore. The Chief Minister assured strict action regarding forged signatures on fake appointment letters.

headline: Kejriwal Unveils Six Guarantees for Goa
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal announced six guarantees for voters in Goa, highlighting free power and financial aid for women. The promises aim to give residents a glimpse of governance under the party.

headline: Suspected Drug Supplier Apprehended in Goa
summary: EAGLE Force, with assistance from Goa Police, successfully apprehended a suspected drug supplier in the state. Further investigations are currently underway.

headline: Goa Cabinet Clears Key Infrastructure Shifts
summary: The Goa Cabinet approved the shifting of the Mirabag water pumping station to Panchwadi. Additionally, the state transitioned its smart city framework into a state-level Special Purpose Vehicle following instructions from the Centre.

headline: Ranji Trophy Squad Announced Without Arjun Tendulkar
summary: Goa has unveiled its latest Ranji Trophy squad for the upcoming matches. Notably, all-rounder Arjun Tendulkar's name was missing from the announced lineup.

headline: Veteran Actor Nana Patekar Passes Away in Goa
summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar passed away at the age of 75 in Goa. An autopsy confirmed he died of a heart attack due to artery blockage, and Goa Police registered an unnatural death case as per standard procedure.

headline: Mumbai Professional Builds Successful Saree Business
summary: A woman who quit her corporate job in Mumbai to start a saree business in Goa reported earnings of Rs 87 lakh over five years. Her entrepreneurial venture has flourished in the coastal state.
